pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal dark regions with sharp edge gradients and variable spatial area, appearing larger on the neck and mid-flank, transitioning to smaller circular-polygonal forms on the posterior flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored interstitial pathways. Clear junction nodes are visible where three to four corridors intersect, with relatively uniform pixel thickness throughout the visible area.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged mane silhouette visible along the dorsal neck line against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple small, dark-colored avian silhouettes perched along the dorsal ridge of the neck and back.
